label: analyst at organization
definition: Person X works or worked as an analyst for organization Y.
scope_notes: Explicit analyst-at/with/for and following an industry for an employer qualify. Economist-only, forecaster or specialist descriptions remain ambiguous under the prior analyst boundary. Director, president, lobbyist, partner and generic employment alone do not.
